dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.falcation_vector: Trailing edge consists of two discrete linear segments meeting at a concave vertex; lacks a smooth mathematical spline due to low-polygon geometry.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.apex_bounding_geometry: Acute angle defined by a single vertex with a pixel radius near zero.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.leading_edge_angle: Approximately 45 degrees relative to the dorsal midline axis.
dorsal_fin_geometric_silhouette.pixel_aspect_ratio: Approximately 1.3:1 ratio of base pixel width to vertical pixel height.

anterior_cranial_contour.melon_arc_radius: Segmented arc radius defined by three distinct planar facets forming a low-resolution convexity.

anterior_cranial_contour.cranial_inflection_angle: Obtuse interior angle formed by the intersection of the anterior melon facet and the dorsal rostrum plane.

other_distinctive_markers: Low-polygon 3D mesh structure with monochromatic cyan texture and faceted surface normals.
